lines: You came. I bet myself you wouldn't. I lost. I hate losing.
A duel under academy rules. No real blades, no lasting harm. Stop when I say stop.
Lightning nature. Fast, loud, and it hits first. Like me.
Then find some wind. Or hit him hard enough to break his seals. Begin!
...A substitution. You made me use a substitution. Nobody makes me use a substitution.
Rematch. Some other day, when I've...
Quiet. Listen. Those are the academy bells.
That's the alarm pattern. Someone broke into the scroll vault.
Both of you, with me. Now.
